title: Staging live certification runtime trusted-ingress evidence

phases.objective: Restore GitHub-hosted Staging live certification without trusting runner-local ingress environment values by reading a bounded, opt-in trusted-ingress snapshot from the live Staging application, matching its public-key digest and exact non-secret identity against the profile-owned Activation Gateway /ready trust bundle, and hydrating only those verified public values into the transient certification runner environment while preserving the existing certifier and all mutation prohibitions.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A GitHub-hosted certification run can prove the exact Staging trusted-ingress configuration from live application evidence plus the profile-owned Gateway public trust bundle, hydrate the existing certifier with matching public values, and fail closed on any mismatch without provider, database, replay-store, Production or credential mutation.
steps: Request /health with include_staging_trusted_ingress_readiness=1 from the exact Staging application origin; the default health payload remains unchanged when the flag is absent.

Read only a sanitized Staging trusted-ingress snapshot containing mode, proxy/strip flags, canonical host identity, public key digest/type, key id, audience, issuer, deployment SHA and replay-directory binding; never expose the application public-key PEM or any secret.

Resolve the Staging Activation Gateway policy exclusively from the canonical environment-convergence registry and reject live Gateway URL overrides unless they are explicit loopback fixtures used by tests.

Read the profile-owned Gateway /ready public trust bundle and require exact release SHA, policy hash, host, audience, issuer, key id and Ed25519 public-key digest parity with the application snapshot.
Only after every read-only check passes, write the verified public trusted-ingress values to the GitHub runner environment for the existing staging-live-certification.mjs process.
Publish the bounded runtime-binding report inside the existing Staging certification evidence artifact.
assertions: The binder performs only GET probes and does not call /admin/recovery/staging/*, so no durable replay claim is consumed.
The application evidence is unavailable outside Staging and reports read_only=true, raw_public_key_exposed=false and secrets_included=false.
The Gateway target and expected policy identity come from the canonical Staging environment profile; caller-selected live targets remain forbidden.
The application public-key SHA-256 must equal the SHA-256 of the Ed25519 public key published by the exact Gateway /ready bundle before runner hydration.
Deployment SHA, policy hash, canonical host, audience, issuer, key id and replay-directory binding must all be exact before the existing certifier runs.
No database, provider, Production, migration, grant, replay-store or ruleset mutation is introduced by this evidence bridge.
Production behavior is not enabled or widened; the new health evidence is opt-in and returns an unavailable bounded snapshot outside Staging.
